name: Capel Sound
intro: Capel Sound is the western half of what was, until 2017, simply called Rosebud West, and the renaming did the place a quiet favour. It is now its own town in the postcodes if not yet in everyone's mental map: a long stretch of bayside foreshore camping ground, a small but lengthening main road of cafés and surf shops, and a residential grid that runs back from the beach in long flat blocks. The Rosebud-Capel Sound foreshore camp is one of the largest beachfront camping grounds in Australia, and for two months every summer it doubles the population of the entire stretch. Outside that window Capel Sound is calm, flat, and uncomplicated  -  a town that locals use when they want a bay-side walk that isn't busy. Stay here for foreshore camping or a cheaper inland rental; for restaurants, walk or drive five minutes into Rosebud.
factualLede: Capel Sound is a bayside town on the Mornington Peninsula's Port Phillip coast immediately west of Rosebud, 75 km from Melbourne, with a long bay beach, the Rosebud Foreshore camping ground and a developing café strip.

heroImage.alt: Foreshore camping with tents set behind tea-tree dunes at Capel Sound

tldr: Capel Sound is the bayside town west of Rosebud - long foreshore, one of Australia's biggest beachfront camp grounds, a flat residential grid behind.
Best for: summer foreshore campers; families wanting a calm bay base outside school holidays; renters chasing lower rates than Rosebud proper.
Signature experience: a long foreshore walk between Capel Sound and Rye at sunset, summer-camp life behind the dunes.
A weekend in shoulder seasons; longer for foreshore camping.
Treat Rosebud and Capel Sound as one continuous strip for restaurants.
notFor: anyone wanting a dense restaurant strip
people who hate caravan crowds in January
stayDuration: two nights minimum, a fortnight if camping
signature: The Peninsula's biggest beachfront camp ground and the quieter half of the Rosebud bay strip.
skip: Visiting in school-holiday peak expecting calm - for that, come in May.
bestDay: Early walk along the foreshore from Capel Sound toward Rye, breakfast in Rosebud, paddleboard or swim by midday, sundown back at the campsite or rental.
insiderNote: Beach-front tent sites on the foreshore camp ground are released by ballot months in advance - register the year before you want to camp.
